description: Take the sale page offline. Existing reservations continue normally — only new visits and new reservations are blocked. The custom URL is preserved, but re-publishing is not a one-click undo: it runs the full publish_page flow, so have the seller's city and state ready. It also does NOT reset the page's expiry clock. If the page expires while it is offline, re-publishing brings back an already-expired page — check page_live in the publish response, and use extend_sale_page if it comes back false.
name: unpublish_page
title: Unpublish Sale Page
